data.title: Delivery standard: west region
data.heading: When a parcel is late
data.text: If a parcel misses its 2-day date, give the customer a new date the same day. If it is more than 24 hours late, tell your team lead; if more than 10 parcels at one hub are late, the team lead opens an incident for logistics.

data.title: Operations meeting notes, 17 Sep
data.heading: Decision: end the backup courier contract
data.text: With Courier Y on target in its first weeks, the west backup courier contract ends. Assumption recorded: Hub W2 alone can carry west volume. Peaks are to be planned with marketing before each sale.

data.title: Winter Sale plan
data.heading: The offer
data.text: 25% off home products for west customers from 27 October, ten days of sale with the code WINTER25. West parcels go through Hub W2.

data.title: Delivery standard: west region
data.heading: What we tell west customers
data.text: Orders in the west region are delivered within 2 days. This standard relies on Courier Y running Hub W2 on time; it was set after the courier switch.

data.title: Operations meeting notes, 18 Aug
data.heading: Decision: move west deliveries to Courier Y
data.text: Agreed to move west deliveries to Courier Y to lower delivery cost (figures in the finance cost sheet). Owner: the logistics manager. Assumption recorded: Courier Y delivers at least 90% on time through Hub W2.
